svg.title: mlp shapes
svg.text: 1.10 The SwiGLU MLP: widen to 8192, gate, shrink back to 2048
out = down( silu(x @ Wgᵀ) ⊙ (x @ Wuᵀ) ); widths drawn to scale (2048 = 160 px, 8192 = 640 px)
animated: x widens into gate and up; silu sweeps over gate; the two multiply cell by cell; h shrinks back to 2048; the residual is added
